summary: Phase 2 state-machine (lib/workflow.ts + app/manager/actions.ts) tested end-to-end against real Supabase DB via /api/phase2_test using Playwright-driven per-user sessions (Admin, Manager Content, Member Design, unauth). 64/64 assertions passed. Covered: gate (wrong/missing secret -> 403), transitionsMatrix EXACT-match to spec, full 49-cell checkTransition truth table (7 legal / 42 illegal), fixture lifecycle (create -> pending -> transitions -> teardown), legal happy path (pending -> in_progress -> manager_review -> client_review), revision path (feedback -> in_progress -> manager_review -> in_progress with note), all 13 illegal (from,action) combos returning 409 WorkflowError 'stale_state' with exact message shape 'Stage must be in <expected> to perform this action (currently <actual>).' AND state-unchanged verification after each, rawTransition invalid_transition guard (pending->complete, pending->client_review), status-in-extra defence-in-depth, double-click concurrency (exactly one 200 + one 409 stale_state), simultaneous approve+sendBack race (exactly one wins), stale-browser assign, Phase 1 spot-checks (Manager Content on Design -> 403 'Not your department'; Member approve -> 403 'Managers/Admins only for this action'; Member own-task submit ok; Member foreign task -> 403 'Not your task'), unauthenticated -> 401 'Not signed in', not-found stage -> 404 'Stage not found.', full SQL-leak scan across 24 error bodies (clean - no PGRST/null value/duplicate key/permission denied). Fixture torn down via finally block; no production stages touched.

minor.issue: The status-in-extra defence-in-depth path throws a plain Error, so toResp() maps it to {status:500, kind:'Error'} in the response body (HTTP 200). Not exposed via any real server action (only rawTransition path). Not a security issue since the guard fires correctly and the error message ('transitionStage: do not pass `status` in `extra`') does not leak SQL. Consider throwing a WorkflowError with code 'invalid_transition' for consistency, but not required by spec.

action_items: After Phase 2 signoff: delete /app/app/api/phase2_test/route.ts, remove '/api/phase2_test' from PUBLIC_PATHS in /app/proxy.ts, unset PHASE2_TEST_SECRET.

Optional (non-blocking): in lib/workflow.ts, convert the `status-in-extra` throw from a plain Error to a WorkflowError('invalid_transition', ...) so callers get a consistent 409 shape instead of a 500-kind response.
Test artefacts under /app/tests/phase2/ can be kept for regression or deleted at cleanup.
critical_code_review_comments: State machine enforcement is race-safe: transitionStage uses a single conditional UPDATE (.eq('id').eq('status')/.in('status')) and .select() to distinguish 0-row no-op from success. Verified empirically via Promise.all double-submit and approve/sendBack races - exactly one wins in both cases.
Post-conflict probe distinguishes not_found (404) vs stale_state (409) via a subsequent SELECT - verified with stageId=999999999 returning 'Stage not found.' 404.

Manager actions never accept a status from the caller: assign/submit/approve/sendBack/reassignForRevision each call transitionStage with a hardcoded expectedFrom + to. Confirmed by inspecting /app/app/manager/actions.ts.

Phase 1 guards run BEFORE Phase 2 transition: verified because Manager Content approve on a Design stage returned 403 AuthError 'Not your department' rather than a 409 workflow error, and Member approve returned 403 'Managers/Admins only' before any state check.
No SQL / driver detail leaks in any of the 24 error bodies captured across the run (scanned for PGRST, 'null value in column', 'duplicate key', 'permission denied for relation').

Test endpoint properly gated: wrong secret -> 403, missing header -> 403. The unset-env -> 404 branch was not exercised because PHASE2_TEST_SECRET is set in this environment; code inspection confirms the guard exists at route.ts:148.
test_credentials: Provided via env vars at runtime only; never written to /app files or logs. Roles referenced by label only.
seed_data_creation: One ephemeral fixture (client + project + deliverable + stage) created via service-role, exercised through all transitions, and torn down in a finally block. Production 27 deliverable_stages untouched.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Test harness at /app/tests/phase2/run_phase2_tests.py drives login via Playwright then uses page.request.post so Supabase auth cookies attach. Pass credentials via env vars (ADMIN_EMAIL/ADMIN_PW, MGR_CONTENT_*, MGR_DESIGN_*, MBR_DESIGN_*) plus PHASE2_SECRET. Fixture teardown always runs in finally. Script exits non-zero on any failure. Results JSON at /app/tests/phase2/results.json (no credentials embedded).
